name: CamelVsPirates
summary:
Embark on an exciting journey with Thaira the camel in the UAE's vast desert in this thrilling endless 2D adventure!
Thaira seeks revenge against a sneaky pirate gang led by Captain Hamlan. Guide her through shifting dunes, dodging TNT barrels and cannonballs. Experience the UAE’s iconic skyline as you play.

Collect power-ups, coins, and unlock skills to boost Thaira’s abilities. The dynamic environments and day-night cycle keep the gameplay exciting. Face off against Hamlan in boss battles and aim for a high score. Can you help Thaira outsmart the pirates and become a legend?
